basic_details.job_title: IIT Guwahati Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: A DST-sponsored project at the Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, IIT Guwahati, has one Technical Assistant vacancy for a 2-month appointment. Pay recommended is Rs. 20000 plus HRA at 18% (Rs. 3600), a total of Rs. 23600. The essential qualification is B.tech in Computer Science Engineering (CSE). Candidates apply online on the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell and must send a scanned CV on or before 27 November 2026 by 5 PM. The online interview (Webex) is on 4 December 2026 at 3:00 PM.

how_to_apply: Visit the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati, at https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/.
Follow the instructions and guidelines provided on the portal.
Find the relevant position by searching for the project title as mentioned in the advertisement.
Send a scanned copy of the CV giving details of all educational qualifications, experience, contact address, phone no. and email, on or before 27 November 2026, by 5 PM.
For technical help with the online application, email [email protected].
The notice does not state the address to which the scanned CV is to be sent.

Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, IIT Guwahati

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: B.tech in Computer Science Engineering (CSE). The notice also lists the experience below. Web, mobile and backend development: development, deployment and maintenance of web/mobile applications, dashboards, APIs and databases. Server, network and hosting management: Linux/Windows administration, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, LAN, firewalls, Cloudflare, SSL certificates, application hosting and troubleshooting. IoT hardware and connectivity: sensor and microcontroller integration (ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi), UART, I²C, SPI, wiring, soldering, firmware, testing and device-to-server connectivity. Software deployment and technical operations: Git/GitHub, application deployment, access control, backups, logs, security compliance, technical support and system documentation. IoT systems and field operations: MQTT, BLE, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, LoRa/LoRaWAN, cellular connectivity, sensor calibration, provisioning, maintenance, remote firmware updates and real-time data integration. Development and automation tools: Flutter, React Native, native Android, Python, Bash, PowerShell, Docker, GitHub Actions, reverse proxies and application monitoring. Cloud and network services: advanced Cloudflare features, including proxying, caching, access controls and tunnels. Institutional IT and technical coordination: experience in academic/research environments, restricted networks, IT/vendor coordination and hardware–software troubleshooting. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The notice states that, based on performance, the contract will be extended.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Technical Assistant
content_sections.text: The notice does not state the address to which the scanned CV is to be sent.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the candidate's performance in the online interview. Candidates are required to appear for the interview on 4 December 2026 at 3:00 PM; the venue is online (Webex). Shortlisted candidates will be informed via email on 3 December 2026. No call letter will be sent separately.
